# sonatypeiq_config_oidc (Resource)

Configure Sonatype IQ OIDC Single Sign-On. ~> **Note** OIDC SSO configurations will affect how all users sign in to Sonatype IQ Server. This resource is only supported from Sonatype IQ Server release 198 onwards.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage OIDC Configuration
# Note: OIDC configuration affects how all users sign in to Sonatype IQ Server.
# Use with caution in shared environments.
resource "sonatypeiq_config_oidc" "sso" {
  client_id             = "iq-server"
  client_secret         = var.oidc_client_secret
  idp_issuer            = "https://idp.example.com"
  idp_authorization_url = "https://idp.example.com/authorize"
  idp_token_url         = "https://idp.example.com/token"

  # OAuth2 / JWT configuration
  oauth2_idp_jwks_url      = "https://idp.example.com/jwks"
  oauth2_idp_jws_algorithm = "RS256"
  oauth2_username_claim    = "preferred_username"
  oauth2_email_claim       = "email"
  oauth2_first_name_claim  = "given_name"
  oauth2_last_name_claim   = "family_name"
  oauth2_groups_claim      = "groups"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) The OAuth 2.0 client identifier for the IQ Server.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The OAuth 2.0 client secret for the IQ Server. This attribute is sensitive and is not returned by the server on read.
- `idp_authorization_url` (String) The authorization endpoint URL for the Identity Provider.
- `idp_issuer` (String) The issuer identifier for the Identity Provider.
- `idp_token_url` (String) The token endpoint URL for the Identity Provider.
- `oauth2_idp_jws_algorithm` (String) The JWS (JSON Web Signature) algorithm used to verify tokens, for example `RS256`. `none` is not allowed.

### Optional

- `authorization_custom_params_json` (String) Custom parameters to include in the authorization request, as a JSON object string.
- `oauth2_email_claim` (String) The JWT claim to use for the email address.
- `oauth2_exact_match_claims_json` (String) Exact match claims for authorization, as a JSON object string.
- `oauth2_expected_audience` (String) The expected audience for the JWT tokens.
- `oauth2_first_name_claim` (String) The JWT claim to use for the first name.
- `oauth2_groups_claim` (String) The JWT claim to use for groups.
- `oauth2_idp_jwks` (String, Sensitive) The JWKS (JSON Web Key Set) for the Identity Provider, as a JSON string. At least one of this or `oauth2_idp_jwks_url` must be set.
- `oauth2_idp_jwks_url` (String) The JWKS endpoint URL for the Identity Provider. At least one of this or `oauth2_idp_jwks` must be set.
- `oauth2_last_name_claim` (String) The JWT claim to use for the last name.
- `oauth2_username_claim` (String) The JWT claim to use for the username.
- `token_request_custom_params_json` (String) Custom parameters to include in the token request, as a JSON object string.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID for Terraform State
- `last_updated` (String) String representation of the date/time the resource was last changed

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Existing OIDC configuration can be imported.

# Example
terraform import sonatypeiq_config_oidc.config system-oidc-configuration
```
